headline: London Latte Prices Rising to £4.10 Within 12 Months

cards.title: Satellite And News
cards.text: Minas canopy greenness shows an 8.6% surplus, but news highlights coffee near record highs with a 0.22 net supply pressure.

cards.title: London Price Impact
cards.text: London lattes cost £3.95 today. Our forecast predicts a 2.0% rise to £4.03 in 6 months and £4.10 in 12 months.

cards.title: Buy Now Advice
cards.text: Buy now or pre-pay cafe subscriptions: there is a 0.71 probability that latte prices climb higher over the next 6 months.

vision_notes.text: Widespread greenness has recovered across coffee fields, reflected in an 8.6% NDVI surplus over historical norms. Healthier crop conditions indicate robust yield prospects, signaling increased coffee supply and downward pressure on retail prices.

Despite persistent heavy cloud cover, coffee canopy greenness remains slightly above the five-year average with stable plantation coverage. Robust vegetative health indicates steady robusta yields and a stable coffee supply.
Heavy cloud cover cleared to reveal healthy, green coffee terrain matching five-year norms. This confirms stable crop conditions and steady coffee supply for markets.
